title: Source-bound scheduled-irrigation date-window predicate

equations: When yearendcrp>yearstacrp, scheduled irrigation is allowed iff (t1900-tstairryrx)>1e-3 and (t1900-tendirryrx)<=1e-3.
Otherwise scheduled irrigation is allowed iff (t-tstairrig)>=-1e-3 and (t-tendirrig)<=1e-3.
The crop-relative and absolute-calendar lower-bound operators differ strictly as in B1.11.

scope: isolated pure predicate with both source calendar branches
exact lower and upper tolerance-boundary checks
100000 deterministic source comparisons for each branch
non_goals: crop-year rollover, calendar construction or date decoding
schedule selection eligibility, crop emergence or fixed-event precedence
event creation/application, accepted mass, solute, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: each branch preserves B1.11 comparison direction and strictness exactly
100000 deterministic comparisons per branch pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
